rules.statement: A trial court has a bounden duty to examine and investigate the title in a partition action.
rules.supporting_quote: the court shall examine the title of each party and shall hear and receive evidence in support thereof and shall try and determine all question of law and facts arising in that action in regard to the right, share or interest of each party to, of, or in the land to which the action relates....
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 25(1) of the Partition Act, bearing No. 21 of 1977 as amended
